pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: For any seizure in a pregnant or recently post-partum patient, consider eclampsia and consult the OB Emergencies COGs.
Examine mental status, HEENT, heart, lungs, extremities, and neuro
Patient assist: Vagus Nerve Stimulator (VNS) q 60 seconds, may repeat x3
Isotonic Crystalloid fluid challenge at 30 ml/kg
pl2: Monitoring and interpretation of ECG & EtCO
